objects.name: Anthropic’s Opus 5 Nears Mythos 5 on Finding Bugs, but Falls Short on Exploits
objects.description: Binary-based vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and exploit generation are blocked in Opus 5. The post Anthropic’s Opus 5 Nears Mythos 5 on Finding Bugs, but Falls Short on Exploits appeared first on SecurityWeek .
